notes: He wears the helm and pauldrons from the eponymous set, House Hexos Style armor [verification needed — can't see gloves/boots], and wields a House Hexos Style staff. He has a chest tattoo as well.Which one?
Despite his Imperial-sounding name, he is a Dark Elf in-game. It is vague as to whether this was his birthname or a name he chose for himself.
He is mentioned in the Letter to Orpheon and The Sacking of Bruma.

Pledge: Lep Seclusa: Explore Lep Seclusa and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the person. For the item set, see Orpheon the Tactician (set). Orpheon the Tactician is a Dark Elf commander and a former "Battlefield Emperor" of Cyrodiil. Orpheon broke his allegiance to his previous alliance and recruited despondent deserters into a fearsome army. He has tracked down and laid siege to the hidden island of Lep Seclusa in search of an Elder Scroll that he believes contains a prophecy that will force the alliances to bend the knee and end the Three Banners War. According to Noriwen's findings, there are avenues that suggest he could have Dragonblood in his ancestry. He is fought as the final boss of the dungeon.Add how to activate Hardmode
